library.title: Media
library.intro: Your photos for the profile. The order here is also the order on your profile. Moderation reviews every new photo before it appears.
library.emptyDescription: Upload your first photos above. Without photos, your profile shows a neutral area with your initials.
library.moved: The media item at position {position} is now at position {target}.
library.processingHint: This usually takes a few seconds.
library.dragHint: Drag a photo to another place or choose «Move forward» and «Move back» in the menu.
library.saveError: The order was not saved. The previous order still applies.
library.actionError: That did not work. Please try again.
library.deleted: {count, plural, one {# media item deleted} other {# media items deleted}}

failure.unsupported-type: The file is not a JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC image.
failure.too-large: The file is larger than 20 MB.
failure.unreadable: The file could not be read as an image.
failure.heic-unsupported: We cannot process HEIC photos at the moment. Save the photo as JPEG and upload it again.
failure.missing-original: The file did not arrive completely. Upload it again.

selection.label: Bulk actions
selection.count: {count, plural, one {# media item selected} other {# media items selected}}
selection.error: The visibility was not changed. Please try again.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this media item permanently?
deleteDialog.titleMany: {count, plural, one {Delete # media item permanently?} other {Delete # media items permanently?}}
deleteDialog.description: The original and all image sizes are removed. This cannot be undone.
deleteDialog.error: Deleting did not work. Nothing was removed.

upload.title: Upload photos
upload.label: Photos
upload.dropHint: Drag photos here or choose them.
upload.hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, at most 20 MB per file. {free, plural, =0 {No slots left.} one {# slot left.} other {# slots left.}}
upload.background: Uploads continue when you switch pages in the Studio.
upload.rights: I hold the rights to these photos, and every person shown has consented.
upload.rightsHint: Required for every upload. We store the time of your confirmation.
upload.rightsMissing: Confirm the rights and consents before you upload photos.
upload.visibilityPublicHint: Everyone sees the photo once it is approved.
upload.visibilityMembersHint: Only signed-in, age-verified members see the photo.
upload.privacyTitle: EXIF and GPS data are removed
upload.privacy: During processing we remove all metadata, such as location, camera and date. The original stays private and is never shown.
upload.quotaFull: All {max} slots are used. Delete a media item to upload a new one.
upload.notAllowed: Your profile does not accept new media at the moment.

errors.type: Only JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC.
errors.size: The file is larger than 20 MB.
errors.quota: All slots are used. Delete a media item first.
errors.rights: Confirm the rights and consents before you upload photos.
errors.network: The connection was interrupted. The file was not saved.
errors.missing: The file did not arrive completely.
errors.notAllowed: Your profile does not accept new media at the moment.
errors.noProfile: You need a provider profile for media.
errors.generic: The upload did not work. The file was not saved.

detail.title: Edit media item
detail.notReady: The preview appears as soon as processing is finished.
detail.moderationBlocked: Moderation has blocked this media item
detail.moderationHelp: If needed, upload a suitable photo and delete this one.
detail.altTextHint: Briefly describe what can be seen, for people who cannot see the image. Without text, a neutral text applies.
detail.altTextTooLong: The alternative text can be at most {max} characters long.
detail.membersOnlyHint: Visitors who are not signed in see a neutral area with the condition instead of the photo.
detail.coverHint: The cover photo appears on cards and at the top of your profile. There is exactly one.
detail.isCover: This photo is your cover photo.
detail.coverNotYet: Once processing is finished, you can set this photo as your cover photo.
detail.deleteHint: Permanently removes the original and all image sizes.

state.slow: Loading is taking longer than usual.
state.errorTitle: The media could not be loaded
state.errorDescription: Your photos are saved; only the display failed. Running uploads continue. Reload the page.

onboarding.intro: Upload photos for your profile. Moderation reviews every photo before it appears. You can also skip this step and add photos later.
